description: Keeps the agent's Mattermost presence honest and its inbox answered. On a new prompt the bot shows as 🛠 working; when the turn ends it goes back to 💤 idle. Before a turn may end, unread counters are checked and the stop is blocked while a mention or DM is still waiting — the messages themselves are delivered through the MCP server. Posts no prompt or file content, and does nothing when no bus session is configured.
